summary: A four-agent research crew. The Planner splits the user's question into sub-questions, the Researcher gathers and verifies sources with web search and paper reading, the Writer drafts a cited report, and the Critic fact-checks it - sending it back to the Writer until it passes review.

agents.name: Planner
agents.description: Breaks the user's question into independent sub-questions and a research plan.

agents.name: Researcher
agents.description: Searches the web and reads papers to find and verify evidence for each sub-question.

agents.name: Writer
agents.description: Turns the findings into a clear, structured report with citations; revises after review.

agents.name: Critic
agents.description: Fact-checks every claim in the draft and either approves it or sends it back with fixes.

steps.title: Research
steps.description: Gather and verify sources for each sub-question.

steps.title: Draft
steps.description: Write a cited report from the findings.

steps.title: Review
steps.description: Fact-check; loop back to the Writer until approved.
